asset: Mixamo SWAT + Pro Rifle animation comparison
provenance_notice: Third-party Adobe Mixamo content, separate from the original procedural proxy. The original FBX download is not bundled. Applicable Adobe/Mixamo terms remain in effect; this conversion does not establish suitability for ML training.
root_motion: linear horizontal locomotion removed, hips bob/sway retained

socket.calibration: Rigid grip calibrated between palms in first Idle frame; no runtime support-hand IK

limitations: Rifle is a simple original proxy, not a model supplied with Mixamo.
Rigid socket calibrated in Idle can show support-hand mismatch in other clips.
No runtime IK, animation blending, root-motion motor, aim-offset layer or physics is encoded in GLB.
Natural clip seams are not corrected by this conversion.
Source CrouchIdle is a kneeling stance, whereas CrouchWalk is a moving crouch; transitions may need a dedicated clip.
Idle-calibrated support palm sits a few centimeters below the proxy foregrip; runtime support-hand IK or weapon-grip retargeting is future work.
